ignoreCommand: if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git cat-file -e "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then git diff --quiet "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" HEAD -- .; elif git cat-file -e "HEAD^{commit}" 2>/dev/null && git cat-file -e "HEAD^^{commit}" 2>/dev/null; then git diff --quiet HEAD^ HEAD -- .; else exit 1; fi
